children: Filana Therapeutics announced the FDA has lifted the clinical hold on its IND, enabling a planned Phase 2a proof-of-concept study of simufilam in TSC-related epilepsy.
FDA lifted full clinical hold on simufilam IND, allowing initiation of planned Phase 2a study in TSC-related epilepsy.
Phase 2a is a 16-week, randomized, double-blind trial at 13 U.S. sites targeting 40 patients aged 12–55.
Study will evaluate two doses and assess safety, tolerability, PK, seizure frequency/intensity, nighttime seizures, and sleep outcomes.
Patient screening expected to begin by Q1 2027; all completers eligible for a 48-week extension study.
Company completed trial-readiness activities: CRO engagement, site identification, investigator recruitment, and investigational drug supply in place.
